reviewer: Primary visual review plus independent non-camera motion review
visual_method: Primary review of all nine full-size source midpoint stills and all nine encoded-MP4 playback frames assembled as the native playback contact sheet. Independent review of start/mid/end frames in CUT04,07,08 and foreground silhouette in CUT06.
limitations: Visual effects are deterministic code over concept photographs, not actual documentary process motion.
Whisper verification establishes spoken sentence coverage and edited word; automated playback is not a human listening preference test.
